nodes.label: Monorepo Layout (apps/web,api,worker + shared packages)
nodes.rationale: Structure hosts the required Next.js/shadcn monorepo plus backend, worker, shared packages and infra without premature complexity: packages/db is the sole owner of schema/migrations, packages/domain must be framework-free, packages/validation may depend on Zod but not NestJS/Next.js, infra/helm stays empty until Kubernetes is really needed.
